review.summary: Requesting changes: see P0 findings. The region filter itself is correct; the migration and the retry path are not safe to ship as written.

validation.what: migration against a copy with existing rows
validation.result: fails on the NOT NULL constraint

findings.title: Add the backfill before the NOT NULL constraint
findings.body: The migration adds `orders.region NOT NULL` with no default and no backfill, and no other migration in this change sets it. Existing rows fail the constraint, so the deploy aborts. Add the column as nullable, backfill, then add the constraint in a later migration.

findings.title: Surface the failed charge instead of returning success
findings.body: When the gateway times out, the `catch` logs and returns `{ ok: true }`, so the order ships unpaid. P0 because money is lost silently. Rethrow, or return the failure and let the caller retry with the idempotency key.

findings.title: Return this failure through apiError()
findings.body: The new branch builds the 404 by hand, so clients get a different error shape. Use `return apiError(404, 'order_not_found')`.

rule.quote: Handlers must return failures through `apiError()`, never a hand-built response.

findings.title: Reuse normalizeRegion() from the shipping module
findings.body: Location: src/orders/region.ts:12-30 (not anchored: outside the diff). `toRegionCode` repeats `normalizeRegion` in `src/shipping/region.ts` with one extra alias. Add the alias there and call it, so the two lists cannot drift.

qa_steps.scenario: Run the migration against a database that already has orders
qa_steps.setup: A staging copy with at least one order created before this change
qa_steps.do: Apply the migrations in order, then run the backfill
qa_steps.expect: Every row has a region and the constraint is added without error
qa_steps.watch: Migration duration and lock wait on the orders table

qa_steps.setup: Payment client stubbed to time out once, then succeed
qa_steps.expect: One charge, one shipped order, no order shipped while the charge is unpaid
qa_steps.watch: Count of charge attempts per idempotency key

steps.action: Merge and deploy the API change that adds region to the order payload
steps.why: This change reads the field and rejects orders without it
steps.verify: The staging API returns region on new orders

steps.action: Run the migration that adds orders.region as nullable
steps.why: Old code keeps writing rows without the column during the rollout

steps.action: Run the backfill, then add the NOT NULL constraint
steps.why: The constraint fails while any row is null
steps.verify: A count of rows with a null region returns 0

deployment.rollback: Steps 1 and 2 are reversible by redeploying the previous version: the nullable column can stay.
deployment.point_of_no_return: The NOT NULL constraint: after it, the previous version can no longer insert orders.
watch: Order creation error rate for one hour after step 3
